name: Bacon Fat
siboNotes: Pure animal fat is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated by most SIBO patients. High fat content may slow gastric emptying in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Strain rendered bacon fat while warm to remove crispy bits
Store in refrigerator for up to 3 months or freeze for longer storage
Use for sautéing vegetables or as cooking fat for enhanced flavor
Start with small amounts if sensitive to high-fat foods
nutritionalHighlights: High in saturated and monounsaturated fats
Contains fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, K
Provides concentrated energy at 9 calories per gram
Source of natural pork flavor compounds
